notes: Condition compendium of WT MG1655; every plain-growth condition (glucose, sorbitol+arginine, acetate, OD 2.0, TB, anaerobic) is an untreated control. 'stationary' samples: title says stationary but the protocol calls OD600 2.0 'later-log phase' -> growth_phase left out (conflicting phase evidence); their carbon source is not given. Anaerobic samples: no electron acceptor mentioned, labelled anaerobic_fermentation (inferred); their carbon source and culture mode not given. Lithium acetate (10 mM) labelled other_chemical, adapted (in the medium); carbon_source left out (glucose + acetate). Sorbitol+arginine: single amino acid supplement, amino_acids_supplied left out. Paraquat: oxidative, 30 min, acute.
